claim: To raise an ineffective assistance of counsel claim on direct appeal, a defendant must make specific allegations of the conduct that constitutes deficient performance, and failure to do so renders the claim insufficiently alleged.
initial_reasoning: 984 N.W.2d 261 (North Dakota Supreme Court) holds that an ineffective‑assistance claim on direct appeal must allege specific conduct that constitutes deficient performance; failure to make such allegations renders the claim insufficiently alleged.
